biggest_catch: The friend must register through the referral email/social link, open a new checking account, and complete $250+ direct deposit or 10 debit purchases within 60 days — and you are capped at 5 referral rewards ($500) per calendar year.
catches: Referrer must register for the program and submit valid email addresses for both parties via ReferLive.
Referred person must not already have a First Commonwealth checking account, must register through the referral link, and open a new personal or business checking account.
Personal: within 60 days of opening, complete one direct deposit of $250+ OR ten qualifying debit card purchases.
Business referrals pay the referrer $200 (not $100) but require the business to complete $2,000+ in qualifying deposits within 60 days.
Cap: up to five (5) Reward Cards ($500 value) per calendar year; only the first referrer to enter a person earns for them.
Reward is a Mastercard Reward Card (not cash), delivered 4-6 weeks after all requirements are met; bonus may be reported as income to the IRS.
Program may be discontinued or changed at any time without notice; IOLTA/MJ-IOTA/Estate accounts excluded.

steps: Register for the First Commonwealth Bank Refer a Friend program and submit your email plus each friend's email via ReferLive.
Your friend receives the referral email/social link and registers for the offer through it.
Friend opens a new First Commonwealth personal checking account (Hometown Checking: $50 min deposit; Confidence Checking: no deposit required).
Within 60 days of account opening, the friend completes one direct deposit of $250+ OR ten qualifying debit card purchases.
You receive a $100 Mastercard Reward Card 4-6 weeks after all requirements are met (up to 5 per calendar year).
timing: Mastercard Reward Card delivered 4-6 weeks after completion of all requirements.
